verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has only page titles, such as the Express Annual Report and Return a Business to Active Status, with no published filing deadlines, late-fee amounts or interest schedule. The $150 same-day counter fee and the no-fee initial report note are service and formation fees, not penalties for missed deadlines, so they earn no credit. A state business registry can publish deadline and penalty schedules, so the axis applies, but nothing here shows it.
